remarks: Don't miss this opportunity! This newly renovated, free-standing condo feels just like a house, offering the privacy and space you've been looking for. Step into the bright, airy living and dining areas, perfect for entertaining. The brand-new kitchen shines with stainless steel appliances, ample cabinet space, and modern finishes.  On the upper level, you'll find three spacious bedrooms and two stylish, newly renovated bathrooms. The primary suite is a true retreat with a walk-in closet and a beautifully designed ensuite bath.  The lower level expands your living options with a playroom, an office for remote work or projects, a separate laundry room, and a convenient full bathroom. A unique find in condo living, this home offers everything you need for comfort, space, and style.

facts.laundryLoc: Separate laundry room on the lower level
